reorganization.note: The guide set lives in docs/guides/, one focused notebook per topic; docs/guides/README.md is the table of contents. Every cell of every guide has a stable id (checked by scripts/check_docs.py).

staleDetection.rule: An artifact is stale when its content does not reflect this version value or lastUpdated date.
staleDetection.note: Update this manifest in the same change whenever guide content changes; scripts/check_docs.py fails if a notebook in docs/guides/ is missing from this list or from docs/guides/README.md. Markdown/HTML single-file renders (docs/user-guide-v1.md/.html) are not generated - see the 'No HTML-rendered user guide exists' entry in packages/starlayer/docs/future_enhancements.md; GitHub's native notebook rendering is the current viewing path.
